test_title: PYST 34: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only three people sit to the left of P. Only R sits to the right of Q. Only three people sit between Q and O. X sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of W.

How many people sit between W and Y?
solution: **Given: **O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing north. 1. Only three people sit to the left of P. 2. Only R sits to the right of Q. 3. Only three people sit between Q and O. 4. X sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of W.
